title: BE-DEV-SEED — Idempotent dev seed script
description: Standalone script apps/backend/src/database/seeds/dev-seed.ts runnable via 'pnpm --filter backend seed:dev'. Opens AppDataSource, creates 1 demo org (firm) + 6 users with varied roles (admin, expert_comptable, chef_mission, comptable, auditeur, client_readonly), all argon2-hashed with the same demo password. Idempotent: skips if admin user already exists. Documents the canonical demo credentials in the script's docblock. Maps openspec tasks.md 12.4.

title: BE-INV-01..03 + BE-MAIL-01: invitations create/accept/revoke + EmailService stub
description: Wire POST /organizations/:id/invitations (admin invites by email + roleCode, signs invitation JWT carrying { org_id, email, role_id }, hashes token, persists pending row, ships email), POST /auth/invitations/accept (verifies JWT, creates user if needed, creates membership, marks accepted), DELETE /organizations/:id/invitations/:invitationId (admin revokes pending). EmailService stub honors EMAIL_DRY_RUN by logging instead of SMTP. New error codes: INVITATION_NOT_FOUND (404).

title: BE-ORG-07+08 — Members listing + role change (last-admin invariant)
description: GET /organizations/:id/members gated by JwtAuthGuard + TenantGuard + @RequirePermission('organizations.read'). PATCH /organizations/:id/members/:userId gated by JwtAuthGuard + TenantGuard + @RequirePermission('organizations.manage_members'). MembershipsService.changeRole enforces ORG_LAST_ADMIN: if downgrading the last active admin (countActiveAdminsForOrganization == 1 && target is admin && new role != admin) -> 409. Emits organizations.role_changed. Maps openspec 6.7 + 6.8 + 7.7.

title: BE-ORG-02+03 — GET /organizations + PATCH /organizations/:id
description: GET /organizations gated only by JwtAuthGuard, returns OrganizationsService.listForUser(currentUser.id). PATCH /organizations/:id gated by JwtAuthGuard + TenantGuard + RolesGuard('admin'), calls OrganizationsService.update with URL-id vs token-id check. Maps openspec 6.2 + 6.3.

title: BE-ORG-01 — POST /organizations (create) endpoint
description: OrganizationsController @Post('/') guarded by JwtAuthGuard. Body CreateOrganizationDto. Calls OrganizationsService.create(currentUser.id, input, requestContext) — service already implemented by user. 201 CREATED. No TenantGuard (creating a new org). Maps openspec 6.1.

title: BE-AUTH-03 — POST /auth/select-organization
description: AuthService.selectOrganization(userId, orgId, context) verifies active membership via MembershipRepository.findActiveByUserAndOrganization, resolves role code, signs a fresh access token with org_id + role claims, emits auth.login_success metadata mfa_verified=current. Returns {accessToken, refreshToken, organization{id,name,role}}. AuthController @Post('select-organization') guarded by JwtAuthGuard, @Public not allowed. 404 ORG_NOT_FOUND on no membership. Maps openspec 5.3.

title: BE-ORG-01..03: organizations create/list/update + login populates organizations[]
description: Wire POST /organizations (create + auto-admin membership, slug derivation with collision suffix), GET /organizations (list user's active memberships), PATCH /organizations/:id (admin-only, name-only update — slug immutable). Bonus: AuthService.login now populates the organizations field via MembershipRepository.listOrganizationsForUser, closing the TODO from BE-AUTH-02.

title: BE-BOOT-06: AllExceptionsFilter (global envelope on errors)
description: Wire a global ExceptionFilter that turns AppException + Nest HttpException + unknown errors into the project-wide failure envelope { data: null, error: { code, message, details? } }. Pairs with ResponseEnvelopeInterceptor (success) so every response is shape-stable. Required before any BE-AUTH-* controller can return spec-compliant responses.

title: BE-AUTH-01..05: signup/login/refresh/logout endpoints (MVP, no MFA verify, no select-org)
description: Wire POST /auth/signup (201, emits auth.signup, 409 AUTH_EMAIL_TAKEN, 422 AUTH_WEAK_PASSWORD), POST /auth/login (200 with access+refresh or mfa_required, emits auth.login_success/login_failed/mfa_challenge_issued), POST /auth/refresh (200, rotation via RefreshTokenService.rotate, 401 AUTH_REFRESH_REUSE / AUTH_INVALID_TOKEN), POST /auth/logout (204, emits auth.logout). organizations field returned as [] until BE-ORG-* lands. MFA verify endpoint deferred. select-organization deferred (needs Memberships query).

title: BE-RBAC-04 — PermissionsGuard + @RequirePermission decorator (deny-by-default)
description: @RequirePermission('code') sets metadata. PermissionsGuard requires currentOrg + checks RolePermissionRepository.roleHasPermission(roleId, code). DENY-BY-DEFAULT: if guard runs and no annotation present, 403 RBAC_NO_POLICY_DECLARED (deliberate fail-closed so a forgotten annotation is loud). Allow if role has perm. Maps openspec 7.3.

title: BE-RBAC-03 — RolesGuard + @Roles decorator
description: @Roles('admin', 'expert_comptable', ...) sets metadata. RolesGuard checks currentOrg.role against the allowlist. No annotation → allow (RolesGuard is opt-in, simple cases only). No match → 403 FORBIDDEN_ROLE. Maps openspec 7.4.

title: BE-RBAC-02 — TenantGuard + auth.cross_tenant_attempt emission
description: TenantGuard runs after JwtAuthGuard. Reads org_id claim from currentUser context, looks up membership via MembershipRepository.findActiveByUserAndOrganization. Missing org_id → 404 ORG_NOT_FOUND. Membership absent/suspended → 404 ORG_NOT_FOUND + AuthEventsService.record('auth.cross_tenant_attempt'). Happy: populates req.context.currentOrg={id, role, membershipId}. Maps openspec 7.2 + 7.6.

title: BE-RBAC-01 — JwtAuthGuard + @CurrentUser/@CurrentOrg/@Public decorators
description: JwtAuthGuard validates Bearer token via JwtTokenService.verifyAccessToken, populates req.context.currentUser={id, mfaVerified}. Honours @Public() opt-out for routes like /health/db. Decorators expose req.context.currentUser / currentOrg in controllers. Tests: valid token sets currentUser; missing header → AUTH_INVALID_TOKEN; invalid token → AUTH_INVALID_TOKEN; @Public skips guard. Maps openspec 7.1 + 7.5.

title: BE-AUTH-02 — RefreshTokenService (issue / rotate / revoke + reuse detection)
description: RefreshTokenService.issue(userId, orgId?) -> returns plaintext+stores hash, .rotate(plaintext) -> returns new pair OR detects reuse and revokes family, .revokeFamily(familyId), .revoke(plaintext). Reuse detection (task 4.3): if used_at != null when rotating, revoke all sibling tokens of the family and call AuthEventsService.record('auth.refresh_token_reuse_detected'). Maps openspec tasks.md 4.2 + 4.3. Tests: issue+rotate, reuse-triggers-family-revoke, revoke single, revoke family, expiry rejection.

title: BE-AUTH-01 — JwtService wrapper (HS256)
description: Wrapper around jsonwebtoken: signAccessToken(payload) (TTL from config.jwt.accessTtl) + verifyAccessToken(token). Payload shape: { sub: userId, org_id?, role?, iat, exp }. Tests: roundtrip, expired token rejection, tampered signature rejection, wrong secret rejection. Maps openspec tasks.md 4.1.

title: BE-AUDIT-01 — AuthEventsService.record()
description: Thin service wrapper around AuthEventRepository (BE-DB-11) that accepts a typed RequestContext (ip, userAgent, userId?, organizationId?, metadata?) and persists an auth_events row. Maps openspec tasks.md 9.1. Tests: record happy path, missing user/org allowed for failed-login events, metadata default empty object, ip+ua propagated.

title: BE-CRYPTO-04: RefreshTokenService (rotation + reuse detection)
description: Wire RefreshTokenService per docs/plans/backend-auth-organizations.md §3 BE-CRYPTO-04. Issue opaque 256-bit refresh tokens (SHA-256 hash stored in refresh_tokens.token_hash), rotate on each use (mark old usedAt, emit new with same familyId), detect replay of an already-consumed/revoked token (revoke entire family + emit auth.refresh_token_reuse_detected + throw AUTH_REFRESH_REUSE 401). Inject Clock for deterministic tests.

title: BE-CRYPTO-03: JwtTokenService (HS256 access + mfa_challenge)
description: Wire JwtTokenService per docs/plans/backend-auth-organizations.md §3 BE-CRYPTO-03. Sign/verify HS256 access tokens (TTL = JWT_ACCESS_TTL) and short-lived mfa_challenge tokens (TTL 5m). Cross-purpose tokens (access used as mfa_challenge or vice-versa) MUST be rejected via a 'purpose' claim. Failures throw AppException(AUTH_INVALID_TOKEN, 401).

title: BE-CRYPTO-02 — EncryptionService (AES-256-GCM)
description: Implement EncryptionService.encrypt() / decrypt() using AES-256-GCM with key from MFA_ENCRYPTION_KEY env var (32 bytes, base64-encoded). Used to encrypt TOTP secrets in mfa_configs.secret_encrypted. Unit tests: roundtrip, wrong key rejection, tampered ciphertext rejection. Maps to openspec tasks.md sections 3.2 + 3.3.

title: BE-CRYPTO-01 — PasswordService (argon2id)
description: Implement PasswordService.hash() / verify() using argon2id with OWASP 2024 params (memoryCost 19MiB, timeCost 2, parallelism 1). Used by signup, login, password change. Unit tests: roundtrip hash/verify, wrong password rejection, invalid hash rejection. Maps to openspec tasks.md sections 3.1 + 3.3.

title: BE-DB-11: TypeORM entities + repositories (auth/orgs/rbac/audit)
description: Create entities reflecting migrations 0001-0010 and repositories enforcing organizationId invariant on multi-tenant tables.
close_reason: BE-DB-11: 41 files (4 migrations + 10 entities + 10 repositories + 4 modules + tenant scope guard + tests). pnpm typecheck/lint/build/test all green (88/88 tests pass). Multi-tenant invariant enforced via TenantId brand + assertTenantId runtime guard on memberships/invitations repos.

title: BE-DB-03 - Migration table roles + seed
description: Create TypeORM migration 0003_create_roles.ts: table roles (id, code UNIQUE, name, description, is_system) + seed des 6 roles systeme (admin, expert_comptable, chef_mission, comptable, auditeur, client_readonly). up = create+insert, down = delete+drop.
close_reason: Migration 0003_create_roles.ts créée : table roles (id UUID, code UNIQUE, name, description, is_system) + seed des 6 rôles système (admin, expert_comptable, chef_mission, comptable, auditeur, client_readonly). up = CREATE TABLE + INSERT idempotent (ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING). down = DELETE des 6 codes + DROP TABLE. Aucune autre table touchée.

title: BE-DB-02 - Migration table users
description: Create TypeORM migration 0002_create_users.ts with CITEXT email, password_hash, names, locale, is_active, timestamps and soft delete. Activate citext extension. UNIQUE constraint on email (case-insensitive via CITEXT).
close_reason: Migration 0002_create_users.ts créée: extension citext activée, table users avec email CITEXT UNIQUE (case-insensitive), password_hash, first_name/last_name, locale 'fr-FR', is_active, timestamps avec soft-delete. Aucune FK (deferred jusqu'à création des tables liées). Index sur deleted_at.

title: Tune TypeORM retry params for Supabase Supavisor
description: BE-BOOT-03 wires TypeOrmModule with default retry policy (10 attempts x 3s = 30 failed logins/boot on bad creds). Supavisor circuit-breakers the project for ~10-15 min after ~27 failures, blocking even legitimate connections. Recommended config: retryAttempts: 2, retryDelay: 5000. Already applied in the local working tree on apps/backend/src/database/database.module.ts — review and keep on commit. See bd memories 'supavisor-circuit-breaker' for details.

title: Fix double-envelope in /health/db response
description: GET /health/db returns {"data":{"data":{"ok":true},"error":null},"error":null} — the outer envelope is wrapping the inner one. The HealthController already returns {data,error} manually (apps/backend/src/modules/health/health.controller.ts:26), so an interceptor or main.ts setup must be double-wrapping. Likely surfaces when BE-BOOT-07 (response envelope interceptor) lands: either drop the manual wrap from the controller and rely on the global interceptor, or skip the interceptor for endpoints that already return the envelope (@RawResponse() decorator per plan).

title: BE-BOOT-09: Pino logger + request-id middleware
description: Structured JSON logs via Pino with sensitive-field redaction (password, password_hash, authorization, refreshToken, secret_encrypted, backup_codes_hashed). Request-id middleware generates or reuses x-request-id and propagates to req.context + log context with route/status/latency_ms.

title: BE-BOOT-03: Database module (TypeORM + Supabase) + /health/db
description: Create DatabaseModule with TypeORM async config (pool, optional Supabase SSL), standalone DataSource for CLI migrations, migrations folder placeholder, package.json scripts (migration:generate/run/revert), and HealthModule exposing GET /health/db returning {data:{ok:true},error:null}. Reads DATABASE_URL and DB_SSL from existing Zod config.
close_reason: BE-BOOT-03 patch produced: DatabaseModule + data-source.ts + migrations/.gitkeep + HealthModule (/health/db) + DB_SSL env + migration:* scripts.
